key_insight: MyTm automates melting-temperature prediction in molecular dynamics by modularizing several established melting-point methods and adding ML-based atom classification to enable high-throughput screening.
engineering_relevance: It lowers the manual burden and error rate of melting-point workflows, making rapid autonomous evaluation practical for materials discovery and AI-guided design.
method: Supports multiple MD-based melting approaches: direct-heating, void, modified void, solid-liquid coexistence, and Z methods.
Uses a machine-learning classifier to distinguish solid-like vs liquid-like atoms more accurately than conventional rules.
Provides a fully automated, modular pipeline for scalable melting-temperature calculations.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that robustness and efficacy were demonstrated on several well-studied systems.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the quality and generalization of the ML atom-classification model across different materials and simulation conditions.
paper_title: MyTm: An Automated Melting Temperature Calculation Toolkit
